body:
P2-25 DESIGN, part 6: FOR THE ADVISOR (docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, part 17). RULED 15 Nov (relayed by the lead): D1 accepted after the Lucene cross-check (two rows added: heh with yeh above and heh goal fold to heh; the rest of the table agrees with the Lucene Arabic and Persian filters); D2 to D5, D8 to D10, D12 to D14 accepted; D11 accepted (item N-37); D6 and D7 CHANGED, below.

D1 THE ARABIC TABLE. Default: alef forms to alef; alef maksura, the Persian yeh (U+06CC) and the Urdu yeh barree (U+06D2) to yeh; keheh to kaf; teh marbuta to heh; tatweel and harakat removed (docs/19 section 2 plus its Persian and Urdu variants). The two to look at, lossy on purpose: teh marbuta to heh (the same word typed two ways meets; a few real pairs that differ only there meet too; option: keep apart, fewer false meets, more misses) and the hamza seats on waw and yeh and the lone hamza (default: kept apart; the aggressive folds would also merge words that differ by it).
D2 DIGITS. Default: every Nd digit to ASCII (Arabic-Indic and Persian digits meet the Western ones; no value changes). Recommended.
D3 CHINESE AND JAPANESE BOUNDARIES. Default: the identity key is the WHOLE folded string, no n-grams; a title or artist of at most four Han, Kana or Hangul characters is compared for equality; n-grams belong to the phone search index (B-84). Option: a bigram key (more tolerant, far more complex, wrong merges possible).
D4 KANA AND HAN VARIANTS. Default: not folded (hiragana against katakana, simplified against traditional stay different); aliases are P2-12b, not a fold.
D5 TURKISH. Default: dotless i becomes i (so Simarik meets the dotless spelling, as a YouTube title usually writes it).
D6 CYRILLIC (RULED, changed): yo folds to ye (Russian text routinely writes yo as ye; apart, one song typed two ways would be two songs); short i, yi and short u stay apart (moy and moi are two words) unless the recorded Russian titles of N-16 show otherwise.
D7 INVISIBLE CHARACTERS (RULED, changed): the zero-width NON-joiner U+200C (the Persian half-space) becomes a SPACE, as Lucene's Persian filter does, so the title typed with a plain space equals the stored one; the bidi marks, the joiner, the soft hyphen and the BOM are removed with no gap.
D8 THE PHONE UNICODE DATA. Default: generated from Python by tools/gen_text_fold_table.py (about 64 KB of Dart, 4,928 NFKC mappings), checked in CI.
D9 THE DENSE-SCRIPT THRESHOLD. Default: equality up to four characters; N-16 measures the rest.
D10 ref_merge.title AND artist. Default: add the two nullable columns so the next fold revision can rewrite tombstones (old rows stay NULL). Alternative: do nothing, and the next revision loses the name lookups of every tombstone.
D11 PLAYLISTS OF IMPORTS AND NAVIDROME STARS. Default: not repaired automatically; a new item "Fix this playlist from its link" is proposed for you to place; the person can run "Bring my library over" again for the likes.
D12 VERSION AND NOISE WORDS in Arabic, Russian, Japanese and Korean. Default: English only in slices 1 to 4; a data table read by a native speaker (the owner reads Arabic), added on the evidence of N-16's set.
D13 ONE PULL REQUEST for slices 2 and 3 (default; slice 2 alone makes a duplicate ref for every non-Latin song described again with no id), or two merges with a legacy second lookup in find (rejected: a throwaway fold kept alive).
D14 SIZE L and a new item N-36 (later): delete the one-time repair (the worklist table, rehome.py, the frozen old-fold test, the recheck hold, tests/legacy_fold.py) when the table is empty on every install the project knows, read not assumed, and one release has passed; each piece is marked STOP-GAP(P2-25 one-shot-repair).
NOT PROVEN: the rekey time on 200,000 refs (slice 3 measures it); the phone reading of a split page (read, not run); the owner own server (not read).
